data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing pytest tests for the new _apply_novelty_gate function. All tests must fail before T3 implementation.

## File
tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_novelty_gate.py (new)

## Test cases (all must fail before T3)
1. test_novelty_gate_downgrades_unjustified_new_introduced: relation=NEW_INTRODUCED, no proximity overlap with any defense, escape_rationale absent → severity downgraded to 'suggestion', _novelty_gate_reason='unjustified-novelty-claim'
2. test_novelty_gate_passes_with_valid_escape_rationale: same setup but escape_rationale references a token appearing in diff_text and outside prior/overlap → NOT downgraded
3. test_novelty_gate_skips_when_proximity_anchored: relation=NEW_INTRODUCED but finding cited_lines DO overlap with a defense → NOT downgraded (proximity anchor present, gate does not fire)
4. test_novelty_gate_skips_cycle1: cycle_number=1 → function is no-op, findings unchanged
5. test_novelty_gate_defaults_missing_relation_to_new_introduced: finding has no relation field → treated as NEW_INTRODUCED, gate applies (warning emitted via stderr or _warnings field)
6. test_novelty_gate_returns_relation_distribution_stats: call gate on mixed findings → second return value is dict with keys: new_introduced_justified, new_introduced_unjustified, resustain_of_count, reframe_of_count
7. test_criterion1_token_absent_from_diff_fails: escape_rationale references a line number outside prior/overlap BUT the token is not present in diff_text → downgraded (criterion 1 fail)
8. test_novelty_gate_no_defenses_downgrades_all_new_introduced: defenses=[], cycle_number=2, relation=NEW_INTRODUCED → downgraded (no proximity anchor possible)

## Acceptance
- All 8 tests exist, test file is collected by pytest, all 8 fail (NameError or ImportError for _apply_novelty_gate)
- .test-index entry added mapping runner.py to test_novelty_gate.py with RED marker
- Tests import from dso_ci_review.runner
data.title: T1(RED): Write failing pytest tests for _apply_novelty_gate behavior
